title: Daily classic-pivot × H1 wick interaction — protected holdout confirmation

dataset.analysis_timeframe: Daily classic pivots / H1 terminal and wick observations

hypotheses.market_question: Does the unchanged Daily classic-pivot × H1 directional-wick terminal interaction replicate on the protected 2022-2025 sample?
hypotheses.null: The protected-holdout difference-in-differences interaction is not positive and robust under the frozen gate.
hypotheses.alternative: Strong directional H1 wick rejection carries additional terminal information inside the unchanged Daily pivot core on protected 2022-2025 data.
hypotheses.mechanism: Directional wick rejection is generic exhaustion information; Daily pivot proximity may add a smaller independent contextual premium.

method.primary_endpoint: (core strong terminal rate - core weak terminal rate) - (outer strong terminal rate - outer weak terminal rate), with core 0-20% and outer 30-50% of adjacent daily-pivot spacing.
method.economic_effect_size: Percentage-point incremental terminal probability associated with Daily pivot-core context beyond generic wick exhaustion.
method.event_definition: Classic prior-day NY17 floor pivots; H1 directional wick >=30% strong and <10% weak; terminal labels from pivot-blind ATR24 lagged one H1 bar with 0.75 ATR directional-change and strictly later-bar confirmation.

inference.multiple_testing: one primary confirmatory hypothesis; no primary multiplicity adjustment

execution.same_bar_policy: candidate endpoint cannot self-confirm on same H1 candle

holdout.prior_exposure: Parent Daily/H1 interaction selected on 2015-2021 only; 2022-2025 previously unopened for this question.

provenance.notes: Principal authorized exact 2022-2025 exposure before outcomes. No parameter change from the internally promoted Daily/H1 interaction.
